title: FA3 Office Fabric with isolated LibreOffice engine candidate
decision: Materialize FA3 Office as a Qt6/QML application and shared Document/Office Fabric subordinate to CAP-018 and FA3-DOC-001. Use LibreOffice Core through LibreOfficeKit/UNO/headless as the primary isolated engine candidate after separate License & Rights and physical Current Host admission; do not embed the full LibreOffice GUI. Treat ONLYOFFICE and Apache OpenOffice as references. Queue Calligra as the primary Qt6 UI/workflow donor and Collabora Online as an optional collaboration provider/donor once the exclusive donor-intake slot is free.
approval_basis: Owner approved the final Office Fabric plan and then instructed materialization on 2026-10-01.
